detail: Full summary: The whole-branch review earned its cost: C1 (steady-state full-dataset polling) was invisible to every per-task reviewer because each task correctly removed its render path while the fetch path kept one surviving legacy consumer — only a cross-cutting view caught the aggregate. First-paint and DOM-bound verification measure the wrong axis for steady-state network cost; future scale verification should include a poll-tick network audit (performance.getEntriesByType('resource')).
